name: acad-annotations
description: AutoCAD text and annotation entities: single-line DBText, multi-line MText with inline formatting, leaders and multi-leaders (MLeader) with text or block content, basic Tables built from row/column data, points with point styles, and text style management. All write operations require the AcadMcp .NET plugin loaded inside an open AutoCAD session and run inside a single transaction with a document lock.

tools_summary.name: add_dbtext
tools_summary.description: Add a single-line text entity (DBText / DTEXT) at the given position. Height defaults to 2.5 mm; alignment is one of Left, Center, Right, Middle, BaseLeft, BaseCenter, BaseRight, TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight.

tools_summary.name: add_mleader_block
tools_summary.description: Add a multi-leader (MLeader) whose content is a block reference (e.g. detail bubble). The block must already be defined in the drawing.

tools_summary.name: add_mleader_text
tools_summary.description: Add a multi-leader (MLeader) with MText content. Single segment from arrowTip to textPosition; the dogleg between the leader and the text block is enabled by default.

tools_summary.name: add_mtext
tools_summary.description: Add a multi-line text (MText) entity at the given position. widthFactor=0 disables word-wrap (auto width); attachmentPoint is e.g. TopLeft / MiddleCenter / BottomRight (defaults to TopLeft). Inline MText formatting codes are passed through (\\Pnewline, \\Lunderline, \\C2red).

tools_summary.name: add_table
tools_summary.description: Insert an AutoCAD Table at the given position with rows × cols cells. Optional 2D data array fills cell text top-to-bottom, left-to-right. rowHeight/colWidth are in current units.

tools_summary.name: create_text_style
tools_summary.description: Create a new text style (TextStyleTableRecord) by name with the given font (.shx or TTF face name). height=0 makes the style annotative-friendly (text height set per-entity).

tools_summary.name: delete_text_style
tools_summary.description: Delete a text style by name. Standard cannot be deleted; the style must be unused (no DBText/MText/Dim references).

tools_summary.name: list_text_styles
tools_summary.description: List every text style defined in the active drawing plus the current style name.

tools_summary.name: set_current_text_style
tools_summary.description: Set the active text style for new DBText / MText entities; subsequent text creation defaults to it.

tools_summary.name: set_table_cell
tools_summary.description: Set the text content of a single Table cell by (row, col), 0-based.

tools_summary.name: update_dbtext
tools_summary.description: Replace the contents of an existing DBText entity by handle.

tools_summary.name: update_mtext
tools_summary.description: Replace the contents string of an existing MText entity by handle. Inline formatting codes are preserved as written.
